name: H P C L
why: Profits backed by cash: operating cash flow is 182% of 3-year profit
Sector cycle: Earnings improving but price not confirming
risks: Not at record: quarterly sales, quarterly profit, annual profit
Margins shrinking (7% to 7%) - record profit may be near peak
Working capital stretching - debtor days 10 to 6, inventory days 35 to 38 (rising): check receivables / stock build-up
Latest concall: management tone cautious (headwinds / delays mentioned)
Latest quarter Sep 2026: Weak (sales +33% YoY, profit -6% YoY)
FIIs (foreign funds) cut holding by 1.4 pts in a year

guidance: As a result, our annual target, which we have agreed with Government of India, if I remember correctly, is somewhere INR9,700 crores or in that ballpark.

We have taken -- despite only 9 months left in the quarter or 3 quarters left in this year, we have taken an aggressive target of INR1,500 crores on a run rate basis, and we are going to aim for INR1,000 crores on accrua
capex: As of now, CDU is running at 60% capacity utilization.
We are expecting the refinery to ramp up to the full capacity in quarter 3 and petchem by end of the financial year.
risks: We'll talk about it, but very proud of the way our team fought it on a daily basis bravely and managed to keep the supply chains going in times of high uncertainty.
It poses 4 key challenges to any team like ours, which is operating on it.
focus: As I said, it takes a lot of effort to manage the crisis, and the teams are focused on it.
So at this point of time, we are really focused on -- especially in the short-term money outflow on really critical capex.
So parallelly, we are also focused on nonfuel.
